title: Lab - File content and regular expressions
description: Slice logs and configuration with the text tools.
scenario: Slice logs and configuration with the text tools. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Extract
tasks.instructions: Print only the usernames from /etc/passwd, sorted, without duplicates.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Regex
tasks.instructions: From /var/log/auth.log (or the journal) print lines with a failed password and count them.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Replace
tasks.instructions: In a copy of /etc/hosts, replace every occurrence of localhost with myhost using sed, in place.
